products_package_check.name: products_package_check
products_package_check.value: ("products"."weight_kg" is null or "products"."weight_kg" > 0) and ("products"."length_cm" is null or "products"."length_cm" > 0) and ("products"."breadth_cm" is null or "products"."breadth_cm" > 0) and ("products"."height_cm" is null or "products"."height_cm" > 0)

refunds_origin_check.name: refunds_origin_check
refunds_origin_check.value: ("refunds"."return_id" is not null and "refunds"."reason" <> 'LATE_PAYMENT') or ("refunds"."return_id" is null and "refunds"."reason" = 'LATE_PAYMENT')

returns_amounts_check.name: returns_amounts_check
returns_amounts_check.value: ("returns"."gross_refund_amount" is null or "returns"."gross_refund_amount" >= 0) and ("returns"."deduction_amount" is null or "returns"."deduction_amount" >= 0) and ("returns"."net_refund_amount" is null or "returns"."net_refund_amount" >= 0)
